# dna contact

Contact handles (registrant, admin, tech, billing).

## dna contact create

```
dna contact create [flags]
```

Create a reusable contact handle.

Creates a contact and returns its handle, which `dna domain register --handle` accepts. country is a
2-letter ISO code; phone and phoneCountryCode are digits only (e.g. 90 and 5551234567).

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/contacts`
- **Body:** `ContactCreateInput`
- **Returns:** `ContactCreateResponse`
- **Schema:** `dna schema contact.create` (MCP tool: `contact_create`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--first-name` | string | First name (at least 2 letters) (required) |
| `--last-name` | string | Last name (at least 2 letters) (required) |
| `--email` | string | E-mail address (required) |
| `--address` | string | Street address (required) |
| `--phone-country-code` | string | Country calling code, digits only without +, e.g. 90 (required) |
| `--phone` | string | Phone number, digits only (required) |
| `--postal-code` | string | Postal code (required) |
| `--country` | string | 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. TR, US (required) |
| `--city` | string | City (required) |
| `--state` | string | State or province (required) |
| `--company-name` | string | Company name (defaults to first + last name) |
| `--fax-country-code` | string | Fax country code (max 3 chars) |
| `--fax` | string | Fax (max 15 chars) |
| `--disclose-flag` |  | Publish the contact in WHOIS (unset keeps the registry default) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna contact create --first-name Ada --last-name Lovelace --email ada@example.com --address "1 Example St" --city Istanbul --state Istanbul --country TR --postal-code 34000 --phone-country-code 90 --phone 5551234567
```

## dna contact get

```
dna contact get <handle> [flags]
```

Show a contact handle and its verification state.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/contacts/{handleCode}`
- **Returns:** `GetContactDetailOutput`
- **Schema:** `dna schema contact.get` (MCP tool: `contact_get`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--handle-code` | string | Handle code (required; or argument 1 &lt;handle&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna contact get DNA-12345
```

## dna contact update

```
dna contact update <handle> [flags]
```

Update a contact handle (and the domains that use it).

Changes the contact details. Every domain using the handle is updated; the result lists per-domain
outcomes (some registries require documents or split the handle). Send the full contact: the API
validates it like a new one.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `PUT /api/v1/contacts/{handleCode}`
- **Body:** `ContactUpdateInput`
- **Returns:** `HandleUpdateResultDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema contact.update` (MCP tool: `contact_update`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--handle-code` | string | Handle code (required; or argument 1 &lt;handle&gt;) |
| `--first-name` | string | First name (at least 2 letters) (required) |
| `--last-name` | string | Last name (at least 2 letters) (required) |
| `--email` | string | E-mail address (required) |
| `--address` | string | Street address (required) |
| `--phone-country-code` | string | Country calling code, digits only without +, e.g. 90 (required) |
| `--phone` | string | Phone number, digits only (required) |
| `--postal-code` | string | Postal code (required) |
| `--country` | string | 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. TR, US (required) |
| `--city` | string | City (required) |
| `--state` | string | State or province (required) |
| `--company-name` | string | Company name (defaults to first + last name) |
| `--fax-country-code` | string | Fax country code (max 3 chars) |
| `--fax` | string | Fax (max 15 chars) |
| `--disclose-flag` |  | Publish the contact in WHOIS (unset keeps the registry default) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
# Start from a JSON file, override one field
dna contact update DNA-12345 --email new@example.com --body @contact.json
```
